instructions:
BLIND A11Y PANEL — 15 sites, one question each.
For every site below: visit the URL and judge ONLY accessibility: keyboard operability (can you tab through everything and see focus?), contrast (can you read text on its background?), focus visibility, and meaningful labels (buttons/links say what they do). Answer PASS (usable by a keyboard + screen reader user) or FAIL (any blocker).
IMPORTANT: do NOT open designesy.org/score or any Designesy page to check the engine result — this must stay blind.
HOW TO RETURN: edit the JSON — replace each null in humanVerdict with "PASS" or "FAIL" — then paste your edited JSON as a comment reply on the dev.to post. That is all. ~45 minutes total.
